name: kling-ai
description: Generate and edit images, create videos from text and reference media, and check your Kling AI credits and generation progress.

interface.longDescription: Generate images and connected image series, edit reference images, and create videos with Kling AI (可灵AI). Create product photos, posters, portraits, social media content, and videos with one or more shots. Kling 4.0 supports text-to-video, image-to-video with first, last, and intermediate keyframes, and Omni-Ref with images, videos, audio, and reusable subjects (Elements). It produces 3–30 second videos at 720p, with 1080p available to eligible accounts. Kling 4.0 Flash is optimized for speed and produces 3–20 second videos at 720p from text, a single first-frame image, or Omni-Ref with images, videos, and Elements. Both Omni-Ref models support smart shot splitting and a choice between synchronized sound generation and source-video sound retention. Use models with motion control to transfer a saved motion or a reference video to a subject image. Upload reference images, videos, and audio, manage Elements, browse the motion library, check your credit balance, and track generation progress. A connected Kling AI account is required. Generation uses Kling AI credits. Model availability and supported settings vary by account.
defaultPrompt: Create 3 images as one series: a red panda in a vintage spacesuit exits a space station, passes a window, and looks at Earth.
Use Kling 4.0 for a 20s cinematic clip: a mech slams down, sending rubble and dust flying as the camera rushes in.
Use Kling 4.0 Flash for a 20s 720p clip. Start with my sneaker photo, slowly orbit the shoe, then close in on the upper.
